title: Honest Interval Length for an Optimistic Robust Causal Predictor at the Shrinkage Threshold
banked_reason: Sound maximized decision-limit and honest-inference result; D0.5.G achieved subfield below field floor, paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.4, salvageable=false, improvement_directive=null.
gap_reasons: The target and delayed-shrinkage threshold are inherited from [Xu and Yang](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.12781v2); the delivered contribution concerns the optimal decision limits, certification and original-record transfer.

The note proves terminating approximation schemes but supplies no evaluated two-sided certificates, implemented attaining intervals, or concrete sample-size thresholds demonstrating usable optimized inference.
Its NSW discussion remains prospective motivation, and the delivered benchmark factor of 81920 establishes an order comparison without demonstrating useful precision gains.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived local decision limits and terminating radial certificates, an unrestricted original-record converse, and a data-only globally honest lift. Four D0 rounds resolved the constructive gap, improved the symmetry reduction, revalidated metadata-stale proof evidence, and completed comparator positioning; final math/decision panels and all six citations pass. The novelty referee rated the maximized package subfield below the required field floor (score ceiling 6.7 versus 7.4), so it was banked downgraded before F1; no Lean theorem or substrate promotion was produced.
tldr: At the delayed-shrinkage threshold, root-sample-size marginal-shape changes move the optimistic robust causal predictor at order \(n^{-1/3}\). On the declared fixed-propensity translated-support Lipschitz parent, its unrestricted local absolute-error value and full-parent honest local expected-length value converge to exactly specified Gaussian decision values. Independent rotations of each paired Fourier frequency reduce those programs to separate noncentral chi-square radii, retaining frequency-specific energy. Finite primal and dual certificates, an observed residual correction, and a public original-record lift give arbitrary-accuracy value brackets and finite-sample honest attaining intervals. The declared parent is a strict regular subclass of the published source model; the attaining upper results are scoped to this parent.
gap: The published optimistic predictor and its regular score expansion leave a singular boundary at a translated variance null and critical robustness radius. Quantile-null limit theory and general optimizer confidence sets do not determine this predictor\textquotesingle{}s unrestricted honest precision.
fill: Theorem 3 targets exact limiting decision values and attaining source-data rules; Theorems 1 and 2 target evaluable residual-corrected continuum certificates. Open-ended Question 1 exposes the transfer and certification bottleneck. Theorem 4 supplies a separately certified uniform-factor alternative.
